record.where: The body remembers (v3.19 — the pack authored, the weather interactive, the pushback earned)

clauses.text: six glyphs distinct
Every kind of thing on a back has its own glyph, stamped in texels on the tower
every small thing rolls into one duffel at the base
the gold band law
order-bound cargo wears the gold band, on every glyph (a band row is injected where the shape had none)
cell window and med cross measured in canvas pixels
worn boots/coat on the rig's texels
the coat and boots they bought recolour the rig's own texels over rank's coat
exo struts drawn
the exo's steel struts with lit nodes
the leaf three-way split
one whose path crosses the walker deflects off the coat, or sticks a beat and drops, or passes clean behind
the never-bends law
one that misses NEVER bends its line
the sparse cap
capped at 14

figure.note: the leaf cap reads 14, a gust asked for forty puts no more than it in the air, and the valley's own gusts stay at or under 14

clauses.text: never in snowfall
snow accumulate
by how hard it falls and how still the body is
shed/melt
a working body sheds most of it; warmth and shelter melt it
flakes-not-rain at the settled camera
In the deep north greyfall falls as FLAKES, not more raindrops
the cap drawn on the hood
snow piles on the hood, then the shoulders, then the full cap
drawn in rig-texel space, riding the pack's top crate too
blueprint valid
Choosing a build hangs its BLUEPRINT
refuse-with-why
honest about validity and why — BAD FOOTING, NEEDS WAYLIGHT, MATERIALS SHORT, ANOTHER STANDS RIGHT THERE
exact-lay
Click or E lays it precisely there
keyboard- aim
(or ahead of the walker)
cancel-unspent
Esc, B or right-click folds it away un-spent; a click far past an invalid ghost is a walk order — placement never traps the mouse
move-for-free
V re-hangs an owned structure as a free blueprint and re-seats it exactly
dismantle refund
a structure hands back 60% of its metal

figure.note: the generator's 28 metal hands back floor(28 × 0.6) = 16, and the toast counts 16

clauses.text: ladder fold-back
a ladder folds back onto the pack
escort suck-to-back
finds the crossing you found
companion catch-up
A companion left three hundred units behind catches up on their own

figure.note: v3.31 replaced the 300-behind teleport with a run that closes any gap: the check leaves the companion 520 behind and they run it shut inside five seconds

clauses.text: zero rings on mastered meadow
Calm ground at a sane load (≤62%) never wobbles at all

figure.note: the meadow is walked at a 50% load, under the line, with every roll coming up: no ring, no steadying breath; the line at 62% itself is not sampled

clauses.text: Balance-6 scree
Rough ground has a Balance level that walks it clean — scree 4

figure.note: the check walks scree at Balance 6; since v3.31 a sane load steadies at any Balance, so the scree's own level is not what it measures

clauses.text: a body at that level auto-steadies: a breath of stamina, no ring, walk on
The ring is reserved for beyond-the-kit: overloaded, or untrained on rough country
overload keeps teeth
stumble- survives-chain
A failed ring still costs (the stumble, the dropped crate) but NEVER cancels the strung route — the chain finishes itself
the toggle off-by-default
keep walking when you switch away
Blur with the toggle off still pauses, the old promise kept
hidden-window walking
a 250ms background clock steps the sim, saves as it goes, and hands back to the render loop cleanly on return

figure.note: the hidden walk advances in four or more strides of over ten units each within 1.6 s — a coarse clock, not 250 ms to the beat

clauses.text: no hidden rings
Hidden windows always auto-steady — a ring nobody sees must never hang the walk
save strips the ghost and keeps the snow
saved with the porter

design.what: the fairness pass deleted escortSnap: a junior wedged behind a crossing plans the crossing and walks it under the player's own passable() law — onto the rungs and over, never sucked to your back
the catch-up teleport (300 behind for 7 s, appear at your boots) became a visible run that closes any gap in seconds on the companion's own legs
the ring now needs a reason — overloaded past 1.0, sprinting rough ground, fear, or empty lungs: an untrained body at a sane load on rough ground pays a breath, never a ring
